theme_strategy: Light Theme ONLY (Warm Luxury Archetype). NO pure white (#FFFFFF), NO pure black (#000000).

scales.hero_title: text-[50px] md:text-[70px] lg:text-[100px] xl:text-[120px] leading-[0.9] tracking-tighter

visual_enhancers.textures: Include an SVG noise overlay with 2-3% opacity over major sections to break the digital flatness.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing: p-8, p-12, p-24. Double standard margins.
layouts.bento_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8. Asymmetric spans (e.g. col-span-8 and col-span-4).
layouts.masonry_gallery: Use CSS columns or tailored grid for a high-density, varying-height image gallery.

components.navigation: Floating glass sticky navbar. MUST have `z-50`, `backdrop-blur-2xl`, and solid text contrast. Animated underline on links.
components.buttons: Magnetic buttons with Framer Motion. Pill-shaped or sharp depending on specific CTA. Primary uses deep espresso or copper background with warm sand text.
components.cards: Zero borders, relying on spacing and subtle shadow. Product cards need image reveals and card lifts on hover. NO generic Vercel cards.
components.dashboard: Google Auth protected. Minimalist bento layout using the same color palette but high density. Shadcn UI tables/forms but customized to match espresso/sand colors.
components.loading_screen: Cinematic. Full screen, deep espresso background, champagne gold logo reveal, floating particles, fades out.
components.stats_counter: Animated counters for: 10+ years, 5000+ customers, 3000+ delivered, 100+ custom projects.

content_strategy.manifesto: Numbered chapters for Why Choose Us (10+ years, premium quality, trusted, affordable luxury, custom furniture, delivery, installation).

motion.hero: Masked line-by-line reveal on load. Slow zoom on background image (transform scale 1 to 1.1 over 10s). Parallax effect on scroll.
motion.interactions: Magnetic buttons (Framer motion drag), mouse glow, luxury hovers, card lifts (-translate-y-2), back-to-top.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for manifesto chapters or brand features. Low contrast text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement pure React with Tailwind CSS using .js extensions (not .tsx files).
DO NOT use pure white (#FFFFFF) or pure black (#000000). Strictly adhere to the defined warm luxury tones.
Implement the cinematic loading screen first. It should overlay the entire viewport, show the logo, and fade out smoothly.
The hero section MUST feature a modern Indian living room background with a slow 10-second zoom (scale 1 to 1.1) and a masked line-by-line typography reveal.
The text contrast must be high. Use Dark text (#2D2622) on warm sand backgrounds.
Add WhatsApp deep-links (wa.me/919110690642) on major product CTAs.
The Owner Dashboard requires a hidden route (/admin) with Google Login (use social login component) to manage products/gallery/prices/enquiries.
Never use generic card layouts. Opt for bento box layouts with varying spans and heavy padding.
Use 'react-fast-marquee' for the slow editorial manifesto chapters.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button').
general: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not center everything. Break symmetry.
Never use universal transition (transition: all). Animate specific properties.
Never center align the App container globally.
Ensure robust focus states and accessibility standards (APCA contrast).
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or navbars under content. Always use glassmorphism.
